versions.description_html:
Confused by Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, and Databricks? Compare teams, workloads, control, and cost to choose the right data platform.

Imagine betting your entire data strategy on a platform that leaves your reports crawling, your engineers fighting for control, or your budget blowing up every time a new team needs access. One wrong decision can create years of unnecessary work, and the ongoing friction adds up fast.

In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • Opening: The Platform Choice That Creates Years of Extra Work, 100 words
  • Start With the Simple Mental Model: One Data Journey, Three Approaches, 420 words
  • Fabric: The Managed Analytics Home for Power BI Teams
  • Synapse: The Azure Build-Your-Own Analytics Platform
  • Databricks: The Engineering and AI Workshop
  • The Comparison That Actually Decides It: Team, Workload, Control, and Cost
  • Choose Your Starting Point: Four Real-World Patterns
  • Conclusion: Choose the Work, Then Choose the Platform

Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.

Explore more on M365.FM

  • How to Choose the Right Microsoft Power Platform Tool
  • Azure Databricks - Simply Explained
  • More Data & Fabric episodes on M365.FM
